name: @workspace/tool-ui-qr
description: The QR Code tool's component and definition (D14, docs/tools/specs/qr.md): the definition is the main export, the component loads when the tool is opened, the encoder with the first code (a chunk of its own) and the reader with the first image (a module worker shipped in this package). Records into the tool history through its host; Wi-Fi details and one-time keys only in secret kinds.
